extras.units: metres; Z up in Blender; height 2m
extras.controls: Move hand_ik / foot_ik; move elbow_pole / knee_pole for bend direction. Head, spine and fingers use FK.
extras.garment: Continuous robe with 4 two-bone panels. Large steps or kneeling need manual robe correction.

extras.source_pose: 扫描原始站姿；左手握包，手指表面存在融合，适合小幅握姿调整。

extras.使用说明: 蓝色控制器平移手脚；pole 控制肘膝方向。橙色骨骼旋转身体与头部。Alt+G/Alt+R 复位。Hands_FK 集合内可小幅调整握姿。
